parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7 suggests structural overlap, `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` belong to distinct test classes that verify different behavioural contracts — core state correctness versus idempotency — so their surface similarity is intentional test-fixture duplication, not accidental redundancy. Merging or extracting them would couple unrelated test concerns and obscure the intent of each test class.
